parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.query:
PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(ResourceID) and ResourceID contains '-'
| extend startPos = indexof(ResourceID, "/subscriptions/") + strlen("/subscriptions/")
| extend endPos = indexof(ResourceID, "/", startPos)
| extend subscriptionId = substring(ResourceID, startPos, endPos - startPos)
| project subscriptionId
| summarize by subscriptionId

content.query:
let TotalAlerts = PrancerFindings
    | where isempty(Snapshots) and isnotempty(Severity) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | summarize count()
    | extend AlertType = "Application Alerts";
let HighRiskAlerts = PrancerFindings
    | where isempty(Snapshots) and Severity == "High" and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | summarize count()
    | extend AlertType = "High Risk Alerts";
union TotalAlerts, HighRiskAlerts
| project AlertType, Count = count_
| order by AlertType desc

let TotalAlerts = PrancerFindings
    | where isnotempty(Snapshots) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | summarize count()
    | extend AlertType = "Total Failed Infra Alerts";
let HighRiskAlerts = PrancerFindings
    | where isnotempty(Snapshots) and Severity == "High" and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | summarize count()
    | extend AlertType = "High Risk Alerts";
union TotalAlerts, HighRiskAlerts
| project AlertType, Count = count_
| order by AlertType desc

PrancerFindings
| where isempty(Snapshots) and isnotempty(Severity) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| summarize Count = count() by Severity
| extend Order = case(Severity == "High", 1, Severity == "Medium", 2, Severity == "Low", 3, Severity == "Informational", 4, 5)
| order by Order asc
| project Severity, Count

PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(Snapshots) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| summarize count() by Severity

PrancerFindings
| where isempty(Snapshots) and Severity == '{pRisk}' and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| project Name = Title, Severity, Config_ID = ConfigId, URL = ResourceUrl, Collection = ApplicationName, Company = CompanyName, MITRE_ID = MitreIds, CWE_ID = CweId, Description = Title, Solution = AlertSolution

PrancerFindings
| where isempty(Snapshots) and Severity == '{pRisk}' and Title == '{pAlertName}' and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| project Company = CompanyName, Collection = ApplicationName, Name = Title, Severity, MITRE = MitreIds, URL = ResourceUrl, Solution = AlertSolution, CWE_ID = CweId, Request_Body = RequestBody, Request_Header = RequestHeader, Response_Header = ResponseHeader, Response_Body = ResponseBody, Description = Title, Evidence = AlertEvidence

PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(Snapshots) and Severity == '{pInfraPassFail}' and iff('{Subscription}' != "", tostring(Snapshots) contains '{Subscription}', true)
| mv-expand Snapshots
| extend
    id = tostring(Snapshots.id),
    structure = tostring(Snapshots.structure),
    type = tostring(Snapshots.type),
    region = tostring(Snapshots.region),
    path = tostring(Snapshots.path)
| where structure == 'azure'
| project id, structure, Finding = Title, Severity, Type = type, Region = region, Resource = path, Description = Title, Remediation = RemediationDescription

PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(ResourceID) and DeviceProduct in ('cspm', 'iac')
| summarize count_unique_resourceID = dcount(ResourceID)
| extend label = "Vulnerable VMs"

PrancerFindings
| where DeviceProduct in ('cspm', 'iac') and isnotempty(Snapshots)
| mv-expand Snapshots
| extend Path = tostring(Snapshots.path)
| summarize arg_min(FindingId, *) by Path, Title
| summarize TotalCount = count(), UniqueCount = dcount(DeviceProduct), PathUniqueCount = dcount(Path)
| project Resource = "Total Resource Alerts", Count = TotalCount, UniqueCount, PathUniqueCount

PrancerFindings
| where DeviceProduct in ('cspm', 'iac') and isnotempty(Snapshots)
| extend Path = tostring(Snapshots[0].path)
| summarize TotalCount = count(), UniqueCount = dcount(DeviceProduct), PathUniqueCount = dcount(Path)
| project Resource = "<Total Count>", Count = TotalCount, UniqueCount, PathUniqueCount, unique = 'Unique Resources'

PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(ResourceID) and ResourceID contains "/" and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| extend Resource = ResourceID
| extend resourceId = tostring(split(ResourceID, "/")[-1])
| extend Type = tostring(split(ResourceID, "/")[-3])
| extend Subscription = tostring(split(ResourceID, "/")[2])
| extend SeverityValue = case(
    CVSSScore >= 9.0, 4,
    CVSSScore >= 7.0, 3,
    CVSSScore >= 4.0, 2,
    CVSSScore > 0.0, 1,
    0)
| extend Severity = case(
    CVSSScore >= 9.0, "Critical",
    CVSSScore >= 7.0, "High",
    CVSSScore >= 4.0, "Medium",
    CVSSScore > 0.0, "Low",
    "Unknown")
| summarize Count = count(), Severity = arg_max(SeverityValue, Severity) by Resource, resourceId, Type, Subscription
content.title: App Findings

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where DeviceProduct in ('cspm', 'iac') and isnotempty(Snapshots) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", tostring(Snapshots) contains '{Subscription}', true)
| project Resource = tostring(Snapshots[0].path), Type = tostring(Snapshots[0].type), Subscription = tostring(split(tostring(Snapshots[0].path), "/")[2])
| summarize Types = make_set(Type), Subscriptions = make_set(Subscription), Count = count() by Resource
content.title: Infra findings

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where DeviceProduct in ('cspm', 'iac') and isnotempty(Snapshots)
| mv-expand Snapshots
| extend Path = tostring(Snapshots.path)
| where iff('{SI_resourceid}' != "", Path == '{SI_resourceid}', true)
| project Finding = Title, Severity, Path, Description = Title, remediation = RemediationDescription
| order by Severity asc

PrancerFindings
| where ResourceID == replace('"', '', '{resourceID}')
| where isnotempty(Title)
| project Name = Title, Config_ID = ConfigId, URL = ResourceUrl, Severity, Collection = ApplicationName, Company = CompanyName, MITRE = MitreIds, Description = Title, Request_Header = RequestHeader, Request_Body = RequestBody, Response_Header = ResponseHeader, Response_Body = ResponseBody, Solution = AlertSolution, Evidence = AlertEvidence, TimeGenerated
| order by TimeGenerated

PrancerFindings
| where IsDataQualityIssue and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| summarize Count = count(), SampleFindingIds = make_set(FindingId, 5) by DataQualityNotes, ScanType, DeviceProduct
| order by Count desc

content.json:
## Tier 2 Flagship Analytics: Kill-Chain, Crown-Jewel & AI-Correlation
---
The tiles below are unique to SwarmHack's AI-adversarial schema (`RiskScore`, `Confidence`, `KillChain`, `CrownJewels`) and to cross-`ScanType` correlation against SAST/SCA/DAST/CSPM findings in the same `PrancerFindings_CL` table.

### Kill-Chain Attack-Path Flow
Decomposes each SwarmHack finding's `KillChain` free-text stage-arrow path (e.g. `Initial Access via exposed RDP -> Credential Access via Mimikatz -> Lateral Movement to DC01`) into adjacent Source/Target stage transitions, aggregated across all engagements by how many distinct findings traverse each edge. **Visualization note:** a native Sankey flow diagram is the ideal visualization for this data, but this tile uses `table` as a validated fallback (Source/Target/PathCount) since the exact `sankeySettings` JSON schema could not be confirmed with confidence — see report for detail. **Validation note (2026-08-11):** live-tested against real production data — the query runs cleanly with no errors, but real `KillChain` values observed so far are a flat scan-level string (e.g. `"full"`), not a per-finding stage-arrow path, so this tile will show its no-data message until SwarmHack populates a richer per-finding value.

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(KillChain) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| project FindingId, KillChain
| extend Stages = split(KillChain, "->")
| mv-expand with_itemindex=StageIndex Stages to typeof(string)
| extend Stage = trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", tostring(Stages))
| where isnotempty(Stage)
| order by FindingId asc, StageIndex asc
| serialize
| extend NextStage = next(Stage, 1), NextFindingId = next(FindingId, 1)
| where FindingId == NextFindingId
| project FindingId, Source = Stage, Target = NextStage
| summarize PathCount = dcount(FindingId) by Source, Target
| order by PathCount desc
content.title: Kill-Chain Attack-Path Transitions
content.noDataMessage: No multi-stage kill chains found in the selected time range.

content.json:
### Crown-Jewel Exposure Heatmap
Every crown-jewel asset (`CrownJewels`, mv-expanded and parsed from JSON) reached by a SwarmHack finding, by customer, sized/colored by the maximum `RiskScore` of any finding reaching that asset.

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(CrownJewels) and DeviceProduct == "swarmhack" and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| mv-expand CrownJewel = parse_json(CrownJewels)
| extend AssetCategory = tostring(CrownJewel.category), AssetConfidence = todouble(CrownJewel.confidence)
| where isnotempty(AssetCategory)
| summarize MaxRiskScore = max(RiskScore), MaxAssetConfidence = max(AssetConfidence), FindingCount = dcount(FindingId) by AssetCategory, CompanyName
| order by MaxRiskScore desc
content.title: Crown-Jewel Exposure by Asset x Customer
content.noDataMessage: No crown-jewel-reaching SwarmHack findings in the selected time range.

content.json:
### Crown-Jewel Blast-Radius Graph
Node-link view of which resources/configs (`ResourceID`/`ConfigId` as source) reach which crown-jewel assets (`CrownJewels` entries as sink), with edge weight = `RiskScore`; complements the kill-chain flow above with a topology view for environments where multiple paths converge on the same crown jewel. **Visualization note:** a native graph/node-link visualization is the ideal fit, but this tile uses `table` as a validated fallback (SourceNode/TargetNode/Weight/FindingId/CompanyName) since the exact graph-visualization JSON schema could not be confirmed with confidence — see report for detail.

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where isnotempty(CrownJewels) and DeviceProduct == "swarmhack" and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| mv-expand CrownJewel = parse_json(CrownJewels)
| extend TargetNode = tostring(CrownJewel.category)
| where isnotempty(TargetNode)
| extend SourceNode = iff(isnotempty(ResourceID), ResourceID, ConfigId)
| project SourceNode, TargetNode, Weight = RiskScore, FindingId, CompanyName
| order by Weight desc
content.title: Crown-Jewel Blast-Radius Edges
content.noDataMessage: No crown-jewel blast-radius edges found in the selected time range.

content.json:
### RiskScore vs. Confidence Triage Quadrants
SwarmHack findings plotted by `RiskScore` (X) vs. `Confidence` (Y), quadrant-tagged: **Act Now** (RiskScore>=7 & Confidence>=0.7), **Investigate** (RiskScore>=7 & Confidence<0.7), **Monitor** (RiskScore<7 & Confidence>=0.7), **Backlog** (otherwise) — operationalizing AI trust directly into a triage tool.

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where DeviceProduct == "swarmhack" and isnotempty(RiskScore) and isnotempty(Confidence) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| extend Quadrant = case(
    RiskScore >= 7 and Confidence >= 0.7, "Act Now",
    RiskScore >= 7 and Confidence < 0.7, "Investigate",
    RiskScore < 7 and Confidence >= 0.7, "Monitor",
    "Backlog")
| project FindingId, Title, CompanyName, RiskScore, Confidence, Quadrant, ConfigId
content.title: RiskScore vs. Confidence (Act Now / Investigate / Monitor / Backlog)
content.noDataMessage: No SwarmHack findings with both RiskScore and Confidence populated in the selected time range.

content.json:
### Confirmed vs. Theoretical MITRE ATT&CK Coverage
Contrasts MITRE techniques static scanners (`sast`/`sca`/`dast`/`iac`/`cspm`) merely *tag* ("Theoretical") against techniques SwarmHack actually *walked through* in a confirmed kill chain ("Confirmed"), grouped by technique.

content.query:
let Theoretical = PrancerFindings
    | where DeviceProduct in ("sast", "sca", "dast", "iac", "cspm") and isnotempty(MitreIds) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | mv-expand Technique = parse_json(MitreIds)
    | extend Technique = tostring(Technique)
    | where isnotempty(Technique)
    | summarize TheoreticalCount = dcount(FindingId) by Technique;
let Confirmed = PrancerFindings
    | where DeviceProduct == "swarmhack" and isnotempty(MitreIds) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | mv-expand Technique = parse_json(MitreIds)
    | extend Technique = tostring(Technique)
    | where isnotempty(Technique)
    | summarize ConfirmedCount = dcount(FindingId) by Technique;
Theoretical
| join kind=fullouter Confirmed on Technique
| project Technique = iff(isnotempty(Technique), Technique, Technique1), TheoreticalCount = coalesce(TheoreticalCount, 0), ConfirmedCount = coalesce(ConfirmedCount, 0)
| order by ConfirmedCount desc, TheoreticalCount desc
content.title: MITRE ATT&CK Coverage: Confirmed (SwarmHack) vs. Theoretical (Static Scanners)
content.noDataMessage: No MITRE technique data found in the selected time range.

content.json:
### Executive Risk-Trend / Burn-Down
Daily Critical+High finding counts combined with average SwarmHack `RiskScore`, per customer — board-deck-ready reporting on whether risk is trending down over time.

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| summarize CriticalHigh = countif(Severity in ("Critical", "High")), AvgRisk = avgif(RiskScore, DeviceProduct == "swarmhack") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), CompanyName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Critical+High Count and Avg RiskScore Over Time
content.noDataMessage: No findings in the selected time range.

content.json:
### Finding-Persistence Tracker
Findings that survive multiple scan cycles unremediated, by `ConfigId`/`CweId`/`Title`, sorted by days persisted — reframes the finding store from a discovery tool into an accountability tool.

content.query:
PrancerFindings
| where iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), ScanCount = dcount(ScanId) by ConfigId, CompanyName, CweId, Title, Severity
| extend DaysPersisted = datetime_diff("day", LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by DaysPersisted desc
content.title: Findings Persisting Across Scan Cycles
content.noDataMessage: No findings in the selected time range.

content.json:
### Time-to-Weaponization
Average and max days between a static scanner's (`sast`/`sca`) first discovery of a `CweId` on a `ConfigId` and SwarmHack's later confirmed exploitation of the same `CweId`+`ConfigId` — a window-of-exposure metric requiring both static and AI-adversarial data in one schema.

content.noDataMessage: No CweId+ConfigId pairs found in both static-scanner and SwarmHack findings in the selected time range.

content.json:
### AI-Validated vs. Static-Only Findings
What percentage of `sast`/`sca`/`dast` findings were independently corroborated by a SwarmHack finding on the same `CweId`+`ConfigId` — frames SwarmHack as a triage multiplier that cuts through static-scanner noise.

content.query:
let StaticFindings = PrancerFindings
    | where DeviceProduct in ("sast", "sca", "dast") and isnotempty(CweId) and isnotempty(ConfigId) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | summarize by ConfigId, CweId;
let SwarmhackConfirmed = PrancerFindings
    | where DeviceProduct == "swarmhack" and isnotempty(CweId) and isnotempty(ConfigId) and iff('{Subscription}' != "", ResourceID contains '{Subscription}', true)
    | summarize by ConfigId, CweId
    | extend IsCorroborated = true;
StaticFindings
| join kind=leftouter SwarmhackConfirmed on ConfigId, CweId
| extend IsCorroborated = iff(isnotempty(IsCorroborated), true, false)
| summarize TotalStaticFindings = count(), CorroboratedCount = countif(IsCorroborated)
| extend AIValidatedPercent = round(100.0 * CorroboratedCount / max_of(TotalStaticFindings, 1), 1)
| project AIValidatedPercent, TotalStaticFindings, CorroboratedCount
content.noDataMessage: No sast/sca/dast findings in the selected time range.
